evidenceStatus: development evidence only (all 50 back-test rows were examined before E67); not validated
lead2Accuracy: Lead-2 development back-test, 50 province-quarters 2024-Q2..2026-Q3: accuracy 0.72 (36/50), balanced accuracy 0.68; the early-warning reading 0.78 (39/50). Always-LOW scores 0.64; neither result is distinguishable from it, and the 75% goal is not legitimately met.
